name: madda-erp
description: MADDA ERP — Coffee Processing & Export Management System (Ancient Halo Coffee Export)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @madda/api" "npm run dev -w @madda/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @madda/api && npm run build -w @madda/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run shared:build && npm run db:seed -w @madda/api
scripts.db:setup: npm run shared:build && npm run db:push -w @madda/api && npm run db:seed -w @madda/api
scripts.db:demo: npm run shared:build && npm run db:seed:demo -w @madda/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @madda/api && npm run lint -w @madda/web
